page.layout: One page of text, printed in black letter with Latin in italic. Running head at the top, a centred closing line with a woodcut ornament below it, and a catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: rechtschaffenen Poeten/ vnd nit gemeinen versificatoribus vnd Landfahrern zuverstehen) werden nit alle jahr geboren. Darbey wir es dann auch für diß mal bewenden lassen/ vnd (doch one jemands Nachtheil oder einige verkleinerung) auff ange-[?]Deute[?] weiß beschliessen wollen:

page.notes: The woodcut ornament below the closing line is not text and is not transcribed. The green underline and green strokes under the Latin lines and in the lower half of the page look like scan marks or annotation, not printed text, so they are left out. "Deute" in the third line is doubtful and may be "Leute"; the hyphenated word "ange-" continues on the next line. The printed page number reads "300" in a decorative numeral form. The catchword "Zwo" is read as printed.
